title: eggshells
description: Adds new crafting recipes for a few spawn eggs!
body:
This mod adds a way to craft spawn eggs, something you would only be able to have in creative mode.

**Eggshells** are crafted by placing an egg in a crafting table!

Each spawn egg is crafted by using their respective mob heads.

This mod is just for people who want to play minecraft but with added chaos!!
